quote: The Chart Code Generator (CCG) generates code for table-to-chart transformation, the Chart Replier (CR) generates responses based on chart analysis, and the Chart Quality Evaluator (CQE) evaluates these responses.
We propose Automatic Multi-Agent Chart Evolution (AMACE)... The Chart Replier (CR) generates responses based on chart analysis... We assess performance on ChartQA and Chart-to-Text datasets.

Our proposed approach introduces three key LLM roles to achieve automated chart generation and refinement: 1) Chart Code Generator generates chart code, 2) Chart Replier has the LLM answer questions about the generated chart in relation to the user's objectives, and 3) Chart Quality Evaluator assesses whether the chart is suitable based on the table, user intent, and responses.
